items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 39:1
items.html: (To the question) ZA is built entirely from Ima, who is his Emanator, and every aspect of him is received from the aspect opposite to it in Ima: his KHB HGT from the GAR of Ima, which are the aspect of the Samech, which include KHB HGT up to the chest; and his NHY he takes from the chest and below of Ima, which are the aspect of VAK, as is known. And in this manner are the aspects of his Malchut, which is drawn from the two places of Ima: the Malchut drawn from the GAR of Ima, from the aspect of her Samech, which are covered Hassadim, is called Leah. And the Malchut drawn from the chest and below of Ima, which is the aspect of her sealed final Mem, which is the aspect of revealed Hassadim, is called Rachel. And therefore Leah is discerned as the hidden world, being from the GAR of Bina, which is the aspect of covered Hassadim; and Rachel is discerned as the revealed world, being from the aspect of the chest and below of Ima, where is the place of the revealed Hassadim, as above, in Answer 176. See there. (Part 1, Page 505, s.v. "and with this").
